mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (current level), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through a positive earnings outlook for consumer-facing sectors.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a manufacturing supply shock that reduces corporate output and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to profit margin compression.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals potential Federal Reserve tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12mo change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high quarterly GDP level (GDPC1) above 16000 billion dollars indicates strong economic expansion, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 16000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a rapidly strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) during a housing market recovery signals increased construction activity and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through sector-specific earnings momentum and broader economic spillovers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is rising in the context of a housing market recovery.
